subject: ACME procurement onramp: scheduling & onboarding checklist alignment
messages:
From: Jenna Alvarez <jenna@acme.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 15:21:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Onboarding next steps - vendor setup + PO process
Attachments: ACME_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Priyom / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the quote. We're ready to move forward but need to align on the procurement onramp so our finance and vendor ops teams can finish PO issuance. High level asks:

- Confirm list of onboarding deliverables your team needs (W-9 / tax form, vendor questionnaire, SOC2 evidence, COI).
- Proposed timeline for vendor activation and tentative go-live date.
- Who from Redwood will own PO receipt and billing setup?

Can we schedule a 30-minute alignment call next week to walk through the mutual action plan (MAP) and agree on success criteria? Our preferred windows are:
- Tue 2/23: 10:00 - 11:30 PT
- Wed 2/24: 13:00 - 15:00 PT

I've attached our statement of work for reference. I'll loop Tim Collins from procurement once we have a slot.

Appreciate it,
Jenna
Jenna Alvarez
Head of Procurement, ACME Cloud Services
jenna@acme.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Alvarez <jenna@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 16:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RE: Onboarding next steps - vendor setup + PO process

Thanks Jenna — great to hear. We're aligned on a short MAP to get you activated. Proposed agenda for the 30-min call:

1) Intros & roles (5 min)
   - Redwood: Priyom (account lead), Laura (billing/finance), Marissa (vendor ops)
   - ACME: Jenna (procurement), Tim (vendor ops)
2) Required artifacts (5-7 min)
   - Redwood will provide: W-9, DUNS/SAM details, SOC 2 summary, COI (if requested)
   - ACME to provide: vendor questionnaire, PO terms, preferred billing contact
3) Timeline & milestones (7 min)
   - Target dates: 1) vendor forms returned, 2) PO issued, 3) account activation
4) Success criteria & signoffs (5 min)
5) Next steps & owners (3 min)

Available slots from our side:
- Tue 2/23: 10:30 - 11:00 PT (fits your window)
- Wed 2/24: 14:00 - 14:30 PT

We'll bring a short vendor onboarding checklist (CSV) and a shared Drive MAP link during the call. Please confirm which slot works and who from ACME will supply the vendor questionnaire and billing contact.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.com
From: Tim Collins <tim.collins@acme.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri_yom@redwood.com>; Jenna Alvarez <jenna@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding next steps - vendor setup + PO process
Attachments: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks — Tue 2/23 10:30 PT works for us. Looping in procurement@acme.com for the billing contact; the vendor ops team will complete your questionnaire (attached).

A couple of notes for the call:
- We generally require a 30-day net payment term; if Redwood needs different terms, we'll flag on the PO.
- Our legal may request a few standard redlines; we can surface those after the MAP is agreed.

See you Tuesday.

—Tim
Tim Collins
Procurement Operations, ACME Cloud Services
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Perfect — calendar invite sent for Tue 23 Feb, 10:30 - 11:00 PT.

Action items before the call:
- Redwood (Priyom): share W-9, onboarding checklist (redwood_onboarding_checklist.csv), and SOC 2 summary link in the shared Drive.
- Redwood (Laura): confirm billing contact and invoicing email; confirm standard payment terms we can offer.
- ACME (Tim/Jenna): review & return vendor_questionnaire.xlsx prior to the call; confirm PO timing expectations.

I've also added the MAP draft to the Drive (link below). If ACME can drop answers to Q1-Q4 in the questionnaire, we can pre-populate the PO request to speed issuance.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cACME-onboarding-plan
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2027-01

Looking forward — we'll keep this tight.

Best,
